u87d5419a36: This chapter describes the standard authorization mode
u6238b6157a: Contact a Jieli engineer if needed
ud0a0d59622: ⟦1⟧FW/UFW⟦/1⟧ files support two authorization modes: unrestricted mode and machine-code binding mode.
u2d32a2c50a: ⟦1⟧FW/UFW⟦/1⟧ files authorized in this mode are not bound to any specific 1-to-2 programmer. Any 1-to-2 programmer with a matching KEY can load and program them, with no difference from ⟦2⟧fw/ufw⟦/2⟧ files that have not been authorized.
ub92a0ec42b: ⟦1⟧FW/UFW⟦/1⟧ files authorized in this mode can be loaded and programmed only by the programmer to which the bound machine code belongs.
u0c4aaf541c: Creating a fw file authorized in unrestricted mode
u642b9f01af: On the PC, double-click the executable of the firmware file programming authorization tool, ⟦1⟧固件文件烧录授权工具_(version number).exe⟦/1⟧ (contact Jieli's Shenzhen office to obtain this tool), to open the tool window. Follow steps 1 to 4 shown in ⟦2⟧Generating an unrestricted authorized fw file⟦/2⟧; the window shown in ⟦3⟧Saving an unrestricted authorized fw file⟦/3⟧ then appears. Click "Save" (保存) to save the authorized fw file to the specified directory.
